<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def capbox(f):
    s=f.segmentation; rows=[]; cols=[]
    for n in s['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('b','S') and n['pixels']<=16 and min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])<47:
            b=n['boundary']; rows+=[p[0] for p in b]; cols+=[p[1] for p in b]
    return (min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
for i in range(6):
    action(['LEFT'])
    c=capbox(current_frame)
    print('LEFT',i+1,':',c, 'step',current_frame.step, 'done' if last_action_result.get('done') else '')
    if last_action_result.get('done') or last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('game_over'):
        print('TERMINAL:', last_action_result.get('state'), last_action_result.get('level_completed'), last_action_result.get('game_over'))
        break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def capbox(f):
    s=f.segmentation; rows=[]; cols=[]
    for n in s['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('b','S') and n['pixels']<=16 and min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])<47:
            b=n['boundary']; rows+=[p[0] for p in b]; cols+=[p[1] for p in b]
    return (min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
